Simon Magus

Richard Crashaw (C.) (c. 1613–1649)

‘He offered them money.’—A
CTS
 
VIII.
 18
.
M
ONEY!
 what would’st thou, impious? Look and see,
’Tis Peter, not Iscariot, speaks to thee.
Would’st thou buy God! Nay, Roman change thy tone,
And try to sell that demon of thine own.
